title: Filipino-Style Chicken and Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish made with chicken, rice, and spices, inspired by Filipino cuisine.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add pilaf spice blend and stir to combine.
Add chicken broth and coconut milk, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
Add cooked rice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until rice is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
